level.theme: The consequences of unchecked alchemical experimentation.
level.setting: An abandoned 19th-century alchemical research facility, now overgrown with twisted vegetation and haunted by the remnants of failed experiments. The walls are lined with rusted equipment, and the air smells of burnt herbs and decay.

encounters.hazard: Flickering gas lamps cast erratic shadows; toxic fumes rise from broken vials on the floor.

pickup.name: Vial of Unstable Acid
pickup.effect: Unstable Acid Vial (increases corrosive damage by 30% for all subsequent enemies)

encounters.trigger: Player steps onto a bloodstained workbench, triggering a trap that awakens the Corrupted Alchemist.

enemy.name: Wraith of the Laboratory
enemy.weakness: Vial of Unstable Acid (pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Fog clings to the walls; whispers echo from shattered mirrors.

pickup.name: Catalyst of Combustion
pickup.effect: Catalyst of Combustion (unlocks ability to ignite alchemical substances, dealing area damage)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Corrupted Alchemist, the player finds a hidden lever. Pulling it causes the Wraith of the Laboratory to manifest.

enemy.name: The Hollow One
enemy.weakness: Catalyst of Combustion (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The air vibrates with unnatural energy; the floor cracks and shifts underfoot.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None (boss defeat grants permanent 'Alchemical Mastery' bonus)

encounters.trigger: After obtaining the Catalyst of Combustion, the player activates a ritual circle, summoning The Hollow One.

boss.name: The Hollow One
boss.weakness: Catalyst of Combustion (pickup from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Hollow One using Catalyst of Combustion

level.objective: Survive three encounters and defeat the boss, using pickups from prior encounters to overcome enemy weaknesses.
level.reward: Alchemical Mastery (permanent increase to alchemical damage and item effectiveness)

level.setting: An abandoned underground research facility filled with ash, flickering lights, and the echoes of failed experiments. The air is thick with sulfur, and the walls are lined with rusted machinery and cryptic symbols.

encounters.hazard: Ash storms reduce visibility and slow movement.

pickup.name: Pyro Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30%.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the chamber; Flesh Warden attacks on sight.

encounters.hazard: Electrical surges damage the player if they touch metal surfaces.

pickup.name: Flame Catalyst
pickup.effect: Summons a temporary fire barrier to block attacks.

encounters.trigger: Pyro Core's energy activates the Machine Sentinel's dormant systems.

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava eruptions deal area damage.

pickup.name: Purification Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the exit to the next level.

encounters.trigger: Flame Catalyst's energy destabilizes the chamber, awakening the boss.

boss.name: Infernal Architect
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the corrupted core using Flame Catalyst, then finish with fire attacks.

level.objective: Survive the cursed facility and defeat the Infernal Architect.
level.reward: Access to the next level and a permanent fire damage boost.

level.theme: Horror with tense atmosphere, stealth mechanics, and sequential encounter progression
level.setting: Abandoned psychiatric hospital with dark corridors, flickering lights, and distant screams

encounters.hazard: None

pickup.name: Firebomb
pickup.effect: Firebomb

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Corrupted Nurse to unlock the corridor leading to the next encounter

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights, sudden jump scares

pickup.name: Shadow Vial
pickup.effect: Shadow Vial

encounters.trigger: Use the firebomb to blast open the barrier, revealing the Spectral Patient

encounters.hazard: Flashing lights, echoing screams

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Use the shadow vial to cloak in darkness and avoid the doctor's attacks

boss.name: The Mutated Doctor
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the shadow vial

level.objective: Survive and defeat the mutated doctor
level.reward: Access to next level, experience points

level.theme: Desolation and isolation, with environments that feel abandoned and actively hostile
level.setting: A decaying forest surrounding a ruined research facility, shrouded in perpetual fog and haunted by the remnants of a failed experiment

encounters.hazard: Fog reduces visibility by 50%

pickup.name: Corrosive Arrow
pickup.effect: Corrosive Arrows deal 2x damage to flesh-based enemies

encounters.trigger: Player discovers a torn journal page hinting at a "beast" in the fog

encounters.hazard: Toxic spores reduce movement speed by 30%

pickup.name: Magnetic Trap
pickup.effect: Magnetic Trap detonates on contact, ignoring armor

encounters.trigger: Enemy drop a corrupted research map pointing to the outpost

encounters.hazard: Area is haunted by ghostly whispers that drain sanity

pickup.name: Shrine Key
pickup.effect: None (boss defeat grants access to shrine's safe zone)

encounters.trigger: Player finds the shrine's entrance via the corrupted map

boss.name: The Hollow Watcher
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the corrupted heart using the Magnetic Trap

level.objective: Survive the corrupted forest and destroy the Hollow Watcher
level.reward: Access to the shrine's safe zone and a corrupted artifact for future quests

level.setting: An abandoned 19th-century asylum with sealed doors, flickering lights, and cryptic symbols carved into the walls. The air is thick with the scent of decay and old blood.

encounters.hazard: The spirit's wails cause hallucinations. Player may take 1d4 damage if they fail a Perception check.

pickup.name: Bone Key
pickup.effect: Bone Key - Unlocks a sealed door in the next area.

encounters.trigger: Player approaches the locked door at the end of the corridor. The door creaks open, releasing the spirit.

encounters.hazard: The corpse's decaying touch inflicts 1d4 corruption damage per turn.

pickup.name: Cursed Pendant
pickup.effect: Cursed Pendant - When activated, reveals the Shadow Warden's weakness.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Bone Key to unlock the crypt. The corpse awakens as the player enters.

encounters.hazard: The boss emits a shadow aura that reduces player damage by 33%.

pickup.name: Shadow Heart
pickup.effect: Shadow Heart - Grants 3 temporary health and reveals the boss's true form.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Rotted Corpse, the crypt's altar activates, summoning the Shadow Warden.

boss.name: The Shadow Warden
boss.weakness: Cursed Pendant (acquired in the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the corrupted amulet on the boss's chest using the Cursed Pendant to reveal its weakness.

level.objective: Navigate the asylum, defeat three spectral foes, and destroy the Shadow Warden using the Cursed Pendant.
level.reward: Shadow Heart (grants temporary health and reveals boss weakness)

level.theme: Berserker's Descent: A journey through madness and violence, where the player's rage becomes both weapon and curse
level.setting: A decaying, surreal hospital complex with collapsing architecture, flickering lights, and hallucinogenic gas leaks that intensify the chaotic atmosphere

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling panels and flickering lights create disorienting chaos

pickup.name: Rage Fuel
pickup.effect: Rage Fuel: Increases berserker damage by 50% and reduces stamina drain by 30%

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Mutated Nurse; ceiling collapses, revealing a hidden lab passage

encounters.hazard: Explosive gas leaks ignite randomly, forcing the player to dodge fireballs

pickup.name: Corrosive Acid
pickup.effect: Corrosive Acid: Applies continuous damage over time to enemies

encounters.trigger: Player uses Rage Fuel to weaken the Corrupted Berserker; it explodes, revealing a hidden elevator to the boss chamber

encounters.hazard: Chaotic hallucinations and mirror illusions confuse the player's sense of direction

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None (boss fight concludes the level)

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the boss chamber via elevator; the Fractured One awakens, initiating the final battle

boss.name: The Fractured One
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its vulnerability to Corrosive Acid

level.objective: Survive chaotic encounters, acquire pickups, and defeat the final boss by exploiting weaknesses
level.reward: Access to the next level and a 'Chaos Master' achievement for surviving the brutal difficulty

level.theme: Serene horror: Beauty and tranquility mask malevolent forces lurking beneath the surface.
level.setting: A tranquil forest with ancient ruins, misty glades, and eerie, overgrown stone structures. The peace is disrupted by subtle, unsettling sounds and distorted reflections.

encounters.location: Glade with a still, reflective pond
encounters.hazard: Fog reduces visibility by 33%

pickup.name: Sanctified Talisman
pickup.effect: Obtain Sanctified Talisman, which purifies corrupted areas and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Player notices the water's distorted reflection; the RootSpirit emerges from the pond.

encounters.location: Ruined stone chapel with overgrown vegetation

enemy.name: Cursed Warden
enemy.weakness: Sanctified Talisman (must be activated to weaken the ghost)

encounters.hazard: Cursed Warden's presence causes hallucinations (random environmental hazards)

pickup.name: Caged Spirit Key
pickup.effect: Unlock the sealed door to the next area with the Caged Spirit Key.

encounters.trigger: After purifying the chapel with the Sanctified Talisman, the Cursed Warden materializes from the shadows.

encounters.location: Sealed stone chamber with ancient runes

enemy.name: Bound Guardian
enemy.weakness: Caged Spirit Key (used to weaken the guardian's bindings)

encounters.hazard: The chamber trembles with seismic activity as the guardian awakens.

pickup.name: Rift Key (temporary access to the boss area)
pickup.effect: Reveals a rift leading to the boss fight after the guardian's defeat.

encounters.trigger: Using the Caged Spirit Key on the sealed door releases the Bound Guardian, which attacks the player.

boss.name: Corrupted Grove Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Corrupted Grove Warden using the Sanctified Talisman to target its core.

level.objective: Investigate the disappearances in the serene forest by defeating corrupted entities and confronting the Corrupted Grove Warden.
level.reward: Unlocks the 'Guardian of the Grove' title and grants the ability to purify corrupted areas with the Sanctified Talisman.

level.setting: A whimsical, decaying carnival filled with surreal attractions, flickering lights, and distorted mirrors. The air hums with eerie laughter and the scent of cotton candy mixed with rust.

encounters.hazard: Mirror Maze

pickup.name: Prismatic Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals the true form of illusions

encounters.trigger: Player's mirror reflects the Mimic's true form, shattering its illusion.

encounters.hazard: Illusory Hall of Laughter

pickup.name: Charm of Whispers
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see through illusions

encounters.trigger: The Prismatic Lens reveals the Giggle Ghost's hidden form, disrupting its laughter-based illusions.

encounters.hazard: Twisted Dreamscapes

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: Allows the player to manipulate the Dream Weaver's illusions against it

encounters.trigger: The Charm of Whispers disrupts the Dream Weaver's dream illusions, exposing its core.

boss.name: Dream Weaver
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Dream Weaver by exploiting its weakness to the Charm of Whispers.

level.objective: Navigate the carnival, defeat three illusion-themed enemies, and overcome the Dream Weaver using pickups from prior encounters.

level.theme: Chaotic steampunk with a focus on collapsing environments, mechanical hazards, and the player's ability to adapt their tools to overcome increasingly complex enemies.
level.setting: A derelict steampunk airship, the Ironclad Skybreaker, caught in a catastrophic mechanical failure. Gears jam, steam vents hiss, and unstable machinery creates a constantly shifting battlefield.
level.player_weapon: Wrench Gun (rapid-fire, can disable mechanical joints)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing walkways and steam vents erupting randomly.

pickup.name: Gears of Precision
pickup.effect: +15% Wrench Gun accuracy

encounters.trigger: Player disables the automaton's security protocol, unlocking the path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Explosive steam pressure valves and debris from the airship's collapse.

pickup.name: Thermal Regulator
pickup.effect: Reduces heat damage taken by 30%

encounters.trigger: Player overloads the golem's core, causing a structural collapse that exposes the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: Chaotic clockwork debris, falling gears, and time-loop glitches (slow-motion effects).

pickup.name: Chrono-Shield
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary shield for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player triggers the boss's awakening by disrupting the airship's central reactor.

boss.name: Chronos Warden
boss.weakness: Thermal Regulator (obtained from Steam Golem in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the overcharged clockwork core using the Thermal Regulator.

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing airship, defeat three enemies, and destroy the Chronos Warden's core using the Thermal Regulator.
level.reward: Blueprint: Adaptive Tinkerer's Kit (unlocks a passive ability to temporarily upgrade one pickup's effect).

level.setting: A mysterious steampunk laboratory with rusted machinery, glowing gas lamps, and cryptic alchemical symbols etched into walls

encounters.hazard: Steam vent explosion (20 damage, 30% chance)

pickup.name: Steam Core Capacitor
pickup.effect: Steam Core Capacitor (boosts energy output for devices)

encounters.trigger: Player enters workshop, activates dormant guardian

encounters.hazard: Web trap (slow effect, 50% chance)

pickup.name: Chrono Gear
pickup.effect: Disrupts mechanical timing sequences

encounters.trigger: Player uses Steam Core Capacitor to power a mechanism, revealing spider

encounters.hazard: Steam burst (30 damage, 40% chance)

pickup.name: Aether Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the Golem's chamber

encounters.trigger: Player uses Chrono Gear to disable serpent's traps

boss.name: The Golem of Aetheris
boss.weakness: Steam Core Capacitor (pickup from first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Golem by overloading its core with the Steam Core Capacitor

level.objective: Navigate through the workshop to uncover the Golem of Aetheris and destroy it

level.setting: A floating steampunk city with brass gears, glowing gas lamps, and whimsical clockwork creatures
level.player_weapon: Golem Core (can be upgraded with pickups)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents spew fog, reducing visibility

pickup.name: Clockwork Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the path to the Steam Golem

encounters.trigger: Player uses Corrosive Potion on the spider, revealing a hidden mechanism

encounters.hazard: The golem's punches create shockwaves that knock the player back

pickup.name: Steam Valve
pickup.effect: Provides a tool to bypass the boss's defenses

encounters.trigger: Player overloads the golem with their Golem Core, causing it to explode and release the Steam Valve

encounters.hazard: The dragon's breath weapon creates fire traps on the floor

pickup.name: Celestial Gear
pickup.effect: Unlocks the exit to the next level

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Steam Valve to disable the dragon's core, triggering a final showdown

boss.name: The Clockwork Dragon
boss.victory_condition: Use the Steam Valve to overload the dragon's core

level.objective: Defeat the Clockwork Dragon and retrieve the Celestial Gear

level.setting: The Clockwork Catacombs - A labyrinthine underground facility filled with steam-powered machinery, flickering gas lamps, and oppressive tension. The air is thick with steam, and the sound of grinding gears and hissing valves creates a constant, nerve-wracking atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Piercing Revolver (initial weapon; can be upgraded with Corrosive Agent ammo)

encounters.location: The Golem's Chamber - A cavern filled with rusted gears and steam pipes, with a single path forward blocked by the Golem.

enemy.name: Steam Golem
enemy.weakness: Piercing damage (from player's starting weapon, the Piercing Revolver)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt when the Golem is damaged, creating temporary vision obscurement.

pickup.name: Corrosive Agent
pickup.effect: Corrosive Agent (can be used to damage the Clockwork Warden in Encounter 1)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Golem triggers a collapse, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

encounters.location: The Warden's Corridor - A narrow hallway lined with ticking timepieces and mechanical traps.
encounters.hazard: The Warden's scythe creates whirlwinds that slow the player's movement.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Chrono Core (used to weaken the Steam Titan in the boss fight)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Warden triggers a countdown timer on a nearby control panel, which activates the Steam Titan in the final chamber.

encounters.location: The Titan's Forge - A massive chamber with a central steam-powered furnace and a crumbling platform for combat.
encounters.hazard: Steam blasts from the Titan's cannon force the player to dodge or risk taking damage.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None (boss fight concludes the level)

encounters.trigger: The countdown from Encounter 1 reaches zero, causing the Steam Titan to emerge from the forge.

boss.name: The Steam Titan
boss.weakness: Chrono Core (obtained from Clockwork Warden in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Chrono Core to overload the Titan's core, then deliver a final blow with the Piercing Revolver.

level.objective: Navigate the Clockwork Catacombs, defeat three mechanical enemies, and use collected pickups to overcome the final Steam Titan boss.
level.reward: Access to the upper levels of the steampunk facility and a rare blueprint for a steam-powered grappling hook.

level.setting: A decaying steampunk metropolis shrouded in perpetual storm clouds, with broken machinery and flickering gas lamps. The air is thick with ozone and the distant groan of shifting metal.

encounters.hazard: Steam vents explode on death, creating fog that reduces vision

pickup.name: Conductor Core
pickup.effect: Enhances lightning damage by 40%

encounters.trigger: Player activates the tower's central gear to proceed

encounters.hazard: Golem releases pressurized steam clouds that slow player movement

pickup.name: Pressure Valve Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a steam bypass valve to progress

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Conductor Core to overload the Golem's core, triggering a collapse that reveals the undercroft

encounters.hazard: Raven drops electrified feathers that deal damage over time

pickup.name: Stormforged Key
pickup.effect: Reveals the path to the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Player destroys the Raven's power core, causing a magnetic field that aligns the Stormforged Key

boss.name: The Clockwork Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central cog with a charged Conductor Core

level.objective: Navigate the derelict steampunk city to dismantle the Clockwork Sovereign
level.reward: Clockwork Crown (grants permanent lightning damage boost)

level.theme: Steampunk desolation with a focus on time manipulation mechanics
level.setting: A ruined steampunk city frozen in time, with broken airships, rusted gears, and flickering gas lamps. The air is thick with ash and the distant sound of grinding metal echoes through the desolation.
level.player_weapon: Chronogun (fires time-locked projectiles that can freeze targets in place)

enemy.name: Rusted Chronoguardian
enemy.weakness: The player's chronogun can time-lock its gears, freezing it in place

encounters.hazard: Temporal Static Fields (reduce player movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds on contact)

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Chrono Core (unlocks time-manipulation abilities for 15 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Activate the broken time-compass in the center of the chamber

enemy.name: Time-Phantom
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Core (from Encounter 0) disrupts its temporal form

encounters.hazard: Echoing Echoes (cause 10 damage per second if the player stands still for more than 3 seconds)

pickup.name: Rusted Key
pickup.effect: Rusted Key (unlocks the sealed time-machine chamber)

encounters.trigger: Use the Chrono Core to stabilize the unstable time-portal in the atrium

enemy.name: The Iron Chronologist
enemy.weakness: The Rusted Key (from Encounter 1) can shatter the boss's temporal shielding

encounters.hazard: Time-Loop Vortex (teleports the player to a previous point in the level if they take damage)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Use the Rusted Key to unlock the boss's chamber

boss.name: The Iron Chronologist
boss.weakness: The Rusted Key (acquired in Encounter 2) can shatter the boss's temporal shielding
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Iron Chronologist by destroying his Time Core with the Rusted Key

level.objective: Navigate the desolate steampunk ruins, defeat three temporal enemies, and destroy the time-obsessed Iron Chronologist
level.reward: The player gains access to the Time Core, allowing them to manipulate time on a larger scale

level.setting: A decaying steampunk fortress filled with rusted machinery, flickering gas lamps, and ghostly steam. The air is thick with fog and the distant sound of grinding gears.

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt with toxic fumes (reduces player stamina)

pickup.name: Tectonic Core
pickup.effect: Tectonic Core (increases earth-based damage by 30% for next encounter)

encounters.trigger: Crushing the automaton's joints with the Seismic Hammer causes a hidden gear chamber to collapse, revealing a path forward.

encounters.hazard: Flickering gaslight illusions confuse the player's spatial awareness

pickup.name: Chrono Gear
pickup.effect: Chrono Gear (disables enemy time-manipulation abilities)

encounters.trigger: Overloading the Wraith with the Tectonic Core causes a temporal rift to open, revealing the Leviathan's lair.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing machinery creates deadly falling debris

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None (boss fight concludes the level)

encounters.trigger: The Leviathan awakens upon the rift's creation, attacking with seismic pulses that destabilize the environment.

boss.name: The Clockwork Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Leviathan's core with the Chrono Gear

level.objective: Navigate the derelict steampunk fortress, defeat three guardians, and destroy the Clockwork Leviathan using pickups obtained during the journey.
level.reward: Blueprint: Tectonic Resonance (unlocks a permanent damage boost for earth-based attacks)

level.theme: Serene mechanical harmony corrupted by industrial greed
level.setting: A steampunk garden with brass vines, glowing gears, and floating lanterns. The air hums with soft mechanical sounds and the scent of oil and flowers.

encounters.hazard: None

pickup.name: Gears of Purity
pickup.effect: Gears of Purity (unlocks ability to disrupt mechanical enemies)

encounters.trigger: Player enters the garden, awakening the stag's curse

encounters.hazard: Steam vents deal 5 damage/second

pickup.name: Steam Core Battery
pickup.effect: Steam Core Battery (destroys boss's corrupted core)

encounters.trigger: Golem's malfunction triggers a steam explosion, revealing the pavilion

encounters.hazard: Corrupted garden plants deal 10 damage on touch

pickup.name: Restored Garden Bloom
pickup.effect: Restored Garden Bloom (restores 50% HP)

encounters.trigger: Golem's destruction triggers the gardener's awakening

boss.name: The Clockwork Gardener
boss.weakness: Steam Core Battery (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the corrupted steam core using the Steam Core Battery

level.objective: Restore balance to the Clockwork Garden by defeating its corrupted guardian
level.reward: Garden of Mechanized Peace (unlocks serene combat music and visual effects)
